I1_domain_identity.evidence: canonical Domain enum has 7 values; capability catalog references resolve to all of them.

I2_stage_identity.evidence: canonical Stage enum has 7 values; capability catalog references resolve to all of them.

I3_coordinate_identity.evidence: each (Domain, Stage) pair maps to one identifier; 49-space derivable (7 x 7).

I4_coordinate_cardinality.evidence: 7 x 7 = 49 coordinates; derivable from canonical sets.

I5_contextualization.evidence: capability and process catalogs use ecfConformance as a separate field; do not redefine Domain or Stage.

I6_identity_preservation.evidence: capability ids (dea:capability-...) are independent of any ECF Coordinate; 26 entries with no coordinate-driven identity.

I7_no_cell_population.evidence: capability catalog references 27 of 49 canonical coordinates; 22 legitimately unreferenced (held-unmapped documented for CAND-019).

I8_terminology.evidence: Enterprise Concept Framework (full expansion) consistent across all landed CRs (CG-001..006).

I9_identifier_resolution.evidence: all capability identifiers match the canonical lowerCamelCase pattern.
